notes.title: 🧙 EA UPDATE 12 - THE ASTRAL RIFTLANDS
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/c34e6f6dfa11c032eae1ac423a419fbde96604e5.png"]

It’s been some time but we’re back! With Gamescom and some well-deserved vacations behind us, we’ve been going full force for the past month to bring you our 12th Update!


🌎New Realm
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/88c8cb2430ff7b868082e9b4ddd240c3ec5f0975.gif"]

This realm is known as the Astral Riftlands. Once a magical haven, but extensive spellcasting reduced it to a chaotic mess full of new dangers…


💀New Enemies
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/97f13f679c5e37418ecb12cee14d45032236b8eb.gif"]

Some of those dangers you’ll be facing:

Void Hoppers: groups of weird bouncy creatures that will ambush you from above

Rift Sentinels: turret-like appendages that stay in place to shoot at you

Stinky Crabs: mutated Flesh Crabs that explode on death, leaving behind a damaging cloud


🎯New Objective
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/24883bd720346cf55baab904ec188e3695bb065d.gif"]

A new side objective has also been added to the pool. If encountered, players must try to light a set of braziers in a specific order. If all braziers are lit before the time is up, each player will get a new spell augmentation.


☝️Solitary Focus
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/307a00704f2113919b2da91a57722ef3ee704fd0.gif"]
[p align="justify"]We've also made some changes to the Solitary Focus Covenant. Now, each player can choose for themselves to enable/disable the Covenant (if they’ve unlocked it of course). Matchmaking will still prioritize players with the same configuration as yours, but you’ll no longer be bound to the choice of the team leader.


💪Spell Transparency
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/8740f5e15b1f624d7ed4fca94d9ca76cbc9c744b.gif"]  

One of our most requested features (aside from a new world) was being able to set the transparency of your spells. You can now access this setting in the Video Options, labeled as Spell Visibility.


PATCH NOTES – 0.12.0.5763 (24-09-25)✨NEW
📢 A new Dev: Maria - Marketing Lead

🌎 A new Realm: the Astral Riftlands

💀 3 new Enemies: Void Hopper, Rift Sentinel & Stinky Crab

🎯 A new Objective: Light the Braziers

🏆 4 new Quests
🕹️GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS
✅ Made the Solitary Focus Covenant configurable by player, meaning each player can choose for themselves to enable/disable it when in a party.

✅ Improved Krog’wa’s navigation so she moves towards players faster when far away.

✅ Improved the colliders of Crablings and Tripods (minion enemies).

✅ Improved despawning when enemies are off-screen for too long.

🤝 Updated the colliders in the Pyrestorm Pit to remove some exploitable areas.

🤝 Improved the way the Size stat is calculated to make it more impactful.

✅ Improved the Level Up Menu so all Spells relevant to a specific upgrade are now properly highlighted.

✅ Improved the order in which Quests are listed in the Quest Menu.

✅ Improved the Wizard Activity meter to better represent the matchmaking possibilities.
🎨VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS
✅ Improved the model and effects for the Statue Objective.

✅ Visually increased the size of Sol’phish bullet hell projectiles.

✅ Improved readability of the environment in the Frozen Ancients.

✅ Added visual feedback when the Solar Pulse’s Size gets upgraded.

✅ Correctly set the initial camera position to the spawning position of each player.

✅ Made sure the player always faces the camera when (re)spawning.

✅ Removed the default walking dust effect when moving around as a ghost.

✅ Improved performance by optimizing the Health Potions.

✅ Improved visual consistency between the different Ice Infusions.

✅ Fixed the Fire and Wildfire effects for the Phantom Blades (they were swapped).

✅ Improved visual feedback for Rocky Road spikes that deal Crit Damage (Augmentation).

✅ Fixed some clipping issues on the models for Maggie, Sun Mage, Star Mage and Bryony.

✅ Fixed some render order issues with the lobby beam and the Starfish Mage outfit.
⚖️BALANCING
✅ Decreased the starter value for Pickup Distance, but increased the values for Enchantments to have more impactful skill progression.

✅ Also increased Bryony’s pickup trait from 12% to 20% as a result.

✅ Evasion Mend: decreased the heal from 25% to 20%.

✅ Vital Strike: decreased the heal from 0.4% to 0.3%.

✅ Steady Hand: increased Critical Chance from 20% to 25%

✅ Attunement: increased Cast Speed from 15% to 20%.

✅ Increased the explosion radius of Spell Cores from 2 to 3.

✅ Reduced the spawn distance for Spell Cores so they spawn relatively closer to the objective site.

✅ Improved health scaling for Frostroot so the first one isn’t too hard and the last one isn’t too easy.

✅ Decreased the health of Teethy Worms from 1,000 to 900.

✅ Increased the health of Baby Worms from 50 to 125, and increased their contact damage from 10 to 30.
⚙️STABILITY & BUGFIXES
🤝 Fixed an issue where sometimes bosses would seem to skip attacks.

🤝 Fixed an issue in the Stat Menu where the incorrect Augmentation description would be displayed.

✅ Set the Framerate limit to 60 by default - you can still change it back to your preference.

✅ Fixed an issue where Mushrooms, Statues or Spell Cores would sometimes spawn outside of the map.

✅ Fixed an issue where Falling Stars and Necro Whirl would sometimes spawn outside of the map.

✅ Fixed an issue where insta-killing enemies would despawn them without playing any effects.

✅ Fixed an issue where Krog’wa’s health bar would sometimes show in a staggered state.

✅ Fixed an issue where Falling Stars would sometimes fall in an obstacle.

🤝 Fixed an issue where the mission would end in failure if a client lost connection while loading.
✋ACCESSIBILITY
✅ Implemented a slider for Spell Visibility, so players can increase the transparency of their Spells. 

 
🎉Some honorable mentions
Gamescom was crazy! So many people came to check out the game - thank you all for the love 💖

We recently hired Maria as our marketing lead! 🎉

On September 16th, The Spell Brigade turned 1 year old! 🥳

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/5a7d4959b6efa13dd529be14003f94f8e7c1cc42.png"]  
⌛What’s next?[p align="justify"]The roadmap has been updated.
[p align="justify"]Update 13 is planned for October 22nd, just in time for the spooky season!
[p align="justify"]In the meantime, we’re getting ready for 1.0. 

Enjoy the update, and see ya soon!



BOLT BLASTER OUT

notes.title: 🧙 EA UPDATE 11 - THE BLOATED ONE
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/9d942ba9a4ddea2eac737e936c902b2c05d4a1eb.png"]

We’re hyped to see what you guys think of this one! The 11th Update is here! Here’s a quick rundown:
🐸New Boss🐸
[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdCP_VVrIQY5M4ax-u5SizDc-TuN6j8EbdBpXc5Sw4FUl9Q18Y09QXprCNAbUdmCSTVI78saPxt6Fhlp9t1XDTBCEBWmVJHXq3B7Hfz-MxERVdUkUgYMyfAF1fZrMUDLGGO2uphhw?key=qjKRP685qRt8RF_GEGP04Q"]

Meet Krog’wa, the Bloated One. She has a bunch of cool moves, but I will not spoil them here. You will have to discover them yourself! You can encounter her in any of the realms, as she appears randomly (though you will have to have beaten Sol’phish once to unlock her).

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe-TBJxx25q6PkZ2B0Wkb36oalkhw5hhmqKOaOkdHac4CYHMbwY4NU_2RL412xMIzDZw-SGaiQ3SB7a4HeaFTnJZZpH4WxNM4KaHmd14Ic8UlgmytoVgdNDDr-vH7WQs_rGwHZAMw?key=qjKRP685qRt8RF_GEGP04Q"]
🦑More Sol’phish Improvements🦑
[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXft0z-iemETcfbD2ck8bN410fsBsTNWtr3WbQNa8pDLHWFbEOc51xjtnYy4UHswptlEe0AkyPBorNIBlOO2Fz17bLopt_HAK3S7XTEpYVbGFJGGZwbA5kkYF3UpowvOXKYzVJV_Bw?key=qjKRP685qRt8RF_GEGP04Q"]

Since Krog’wa’s move set is quite expansive compared to that of Sol’phish, we figured we needed to take it up a notch so they are more equally matched. Therefore, we gave Sol’phish two new attacks (one of which you see here), as well as some variations, and different behaviors for each phase.
🎺New Wizard🎺
[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc6MVebcsJ5Qjy4bzZRDfQ1x0pl__DuU_Di1-s-PKqo6U8QKRo2uXG8hw_bjjYYo2mVwtii_H0mZjTZ9ayEPxsAdBpZK0D5Uv7yoeWHBeMMG9ylxVx-2pv6xlYWa0yTzLz8UcJigg?key=qjKRP685qRt8RF_GEGP04Q"]

Meet Pipwick! This fellow marches to the beat, with an army of unhinged impish creatures at his side! He uses his flute mask to cast spells, though his symphonic conventions are deemed somewhat… random.
💪Some more Augmentations💪
[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXejV5qZ4qiTmvalaFLXzX23BxVQlEX77w-ehRyvd17T4ECeJyasliHVmcJu7Erlo_tOlB2LtFDvFrFhD4vLZzIr5I6W3o9V2Yc2yE6Ij1uzr855qhDph6vALjbZ6nLUhGQdpb3R?key=qjKRP685qRt8RF_GEGP04Q"]

With all the new spells being added these last few updates, we occasionally take a look at some of the older ones to see what we can do to keep them up to par. For this update, we gave both the Moonerang and Solar Pulse a brand new augmentation, and have also reworked one for the Rocky Road.

 

Check out the patch notes below for more details. We hope you’ll enjoy this one!


PATCH NOTES – 0.11.0.4763 (02-07-25)✨NEW✨
🐸 A new Boss: Krog’wa, the Bloated One

🧙 A new Wizard: Pipwick

👕 2 new Outfits: Dragon Tamer Pipwick & Pipwick the Tune Tinkerer

✨ A new Spell: Impish Havoc

🌙 A new Augmentation for Moonerang: upon return, Moonerangs make an additional pass in the opposite direction

☀️ A new Augmentation for Solar Pulse: deals more Damage towards its center

💀 Replaced the Flesh Crab variants with slightly more interesting grunts. Meet the Crabling, Tripod and Snipjaw!
🕹️GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS🕹️
✅ Sol’phish, the Long One now has 3 phases, each with their own move set.

✅ Added various bullet hell attacks for Sol’phish, the Long One, that change between phases.

✅ Added a homing projectile attack for Sol’phish, the Long One, that changes between phases.

✅ Made the “More Damage towards the end” Augmentation for the Rocky Road stackable.

🤝 Updated the Cooldown stat to Cast Speed so it can count upwards like other stats (and be less confusing).

✅ Made sure that when leveling up, general stat upgrades that are irrelevant to currently equipped spells are no longer offered.

✅ Added different Stampeder configurations for each Threat Level.

✅ Added different Swarmling configurations for each Threat Level.
🎨VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS🎨
✅ Improved the Boss spawn sequence by making sure a Boss always looks towards the camera when spawning.

✅ Visually updated the health bars for Bosses so they better visualize the newly implemented phases.

✅ Added a delay effect to Boss health bars to improve feedback.

✅ Fixed a UI issue where the Boss health bar would inaccurately show parts of the staggered state.

✅ Fixed a UI issue where the Progress Bar would add double icons when a Boss spawned.

✅ Improved some animations for the Gnasher.

✅ Gave Ghost Players a bit of offset so they don’t spawn inside their Revive Crystal when they die.

✅ Updated the UI for the Spell Slots and their Infusions.

✅ Fixed a UI issue where sometimes selection feedback was visible while nothing was selected.

🤝 Fixed a UI issue when completing a Quest without a reward.

✅ Removed the confusing default “Energy” element from the spell stats menu for spells that have no infusions.

🤝 Made sure the cursor doesn’t reset its position to the center of the screen when switching between keyboard, mouse and controller inputs.

🤝 Fixed a visual issue where the North Star outfit for the Star Mage would have some weird artifacting.
⚖️BALANCING⚖️
✅ Slightly increased the amount of XP needed to level up, per player in the party.

🤝 Slightly increased the general spawn frequency of enemies.

🤝 Decreased the Damage of the Explode at End Augmentation for Falling Stars and Aurora Wings.

✅ Tweaked some Spells so they’re better balanced throughout the whole run:

Decreased Cast Speed of the Astral Orbs, but increased Damage.

Decreased Cast Speed of the Solar Pulse, but increased the Damage.

Decreased Damage of the Aurora Wings, but increased Cast Speed.
⚙️STABILITY & BUGFIXES⚙️
🤝 Fixed an issue where Sol’phish would sometimes push players out of the map during its death animation.

✅ Fixed an issue where enemy spawning didn’t always take the amount of players into account.

🤝 Fixed an issue where some spells were able to target enemies through obstacles.

✅ Fixed an issue where Plasma spell bounces would apply triple the intended amount of Burn Damage.

🤝 Fixed an issue where the Moonerang’s Linger at Furthest Point Augmentation would scale incorrectly, resulting in dealing less Damage than intended.

✅ Fixed an issue where Rocky Road Augmentations would only activate after adding an Infusion.

✅ Fixed an issue where Swarmlings would disappear on the map.

🤝 Fixed an issue where Vengeful Sprout would not target some enemies that appeared in range.

🤝 Fixed an issue where controller and keyboard menu navigation would lose focus after a mouse click.

🤝 Fixed an issue where the wrong pop-up was shown when a Host terminated the session.
✋ACCESSIBILITY✋
🤝 Added a setting that allows players to play with mouse only.

✅ Made the Pause Menu accessible by mouse (middle mouse button).

✅ Made tooltips in the Level Up menus accessible by mouse (right click on an Upgrade Card).

✅ Made the Invite Friend prompt in the Lobby clickable.

🤝 = changes inspired by community feedback



Update 12 is planned for September 24th. A bit longer than usual, but it’s a big one. And the team also has some well-earned vacation days to spend, not to mention that one of us has a baby on the way! Oh, and we’re also attending Gamescom, so we’re not exactly sitting on our hands. But more on that soon!



Enjoy the Summer Sales, stay cool, and see you guys soon!



BOLT BLASTER OUT

notes.title: 🧙 EA UPDATE 10 - FROM THE DEAD
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/05953900e8769713f222b339762067fbbb42c0da.png

Brace yourselves, Update 10 has arrived! We've been hard at work on the game, trying to incorporate as much of your feedback as possible every step of the way. Therefore, we have been busy developing features for both this update and future updates. Nevertheless, this update has a lot of improvements, some reworks, and some new stuff as well. Catch the highlights below, or scroll down for the patch notes!

🪽 New Revive System 🪽
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/988262775fd8ee9cf648d029c6af92b095f51ba1.gif
We’ve reworked the Revive System for multiplayer, so you’ll never sit on the sidelines again! Now, if you die, you become a ghost! As a ghost, you can wander around the map and still collect XP orbs to help your team level up. We’ve also improved much of the feedback so players will be quicker to respond to teammates in need of assistance.

📊 New & Improved Stat Menus 📊
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/7b343c4562637d79bfa1a5fa014a763bebea8713.gif
This has been one of our most requested features, so we’re excited to share our new Stat Menus! Aside from your Player Stats, you can now also access the stats of each of your Spells, as well as view the Relics you collected. You can now also access your performance (kills, objectives, etc.) during the current mission at any time.

🦇 New Wizard 🦇
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/d662cc809565d0c54a0dc6b6987bfc5893ecc58e.gif
The Spell Brigade’s most recent addition to the roster is quite an ominous fellow. Balthazar stalks the mission fields with his melee-focused Talon Slash. He also specializes in Lifesteal and has the unique ability to revive teammates from beyond the grave.

🤔 What’s Next? 🤔
As you know, we put a lot of effort into staying up-to-date on player feedback so we can always deliver on what our players want the most. That being said, being the small team that we are, some of this content, like new Worlds or Bosses, takes a long time to design, implement, and iterate on.

Needless to say, trying to find the right balance between short and long-term development has proved a bit of a challenge. Because we DO want to keep giving you new stuff to check out regularly, and some of these things just take longer than a month to get right.

So if you’re wondering where the promised new world and bosses are, there’s your answer. We’re working on them. Wizards and Spells are just easier to add within shorter releases. But do not worry, they are coming soon! To summarize, here’s a quick rundown of the bigger things we’re currently working on:

☠️ a new Boss
🌎 a new World
👻 new Enemies
🎯 new Objectives
🌐 Matchmaking improvements
🤝 Many more community requested improvements

That’s all for now! Check out the patch notes for Update 10 below:

PATCH NOTES - VERSION 0.10.0.4012 (21-05-25)
✨NEW✨
🪽 New Revive system featuring Ghost Wizards!
📊 New Stat Menus for Spells, Relics & Missions.
🧙 A new Wizard: Balthazar
👕 2 new Outfits: [spoiler]Nightshift Balthazar & Emperor Balthazar[/spoiler]
🦇 A new Spell: Talon Slash
🌱 A new Augmentation for Vengeful Sprout: Each Plant increases Damage and Size by 4% with every attack

🕹️GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS🕹️
🤝 Added the ability to access the pause menu while choosing items or waiting for items to be chosen.
🤝 Made sure all players receive rewards when they get disconnected or leave a match.
✅ Corrupted enemies do extra attacks when they have been overcorrupted.
🤝 Changed the store timer to only start when someone has picked the first item.

🎨VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS🎨
✅ Added a visual effect when corrupted enemies do an attack, and added a unique damage number visualization.
✅ Tweaked the sizes of various wizards so they're more consistent. Fixed some visual bugs/jitter in the idle animations of some wizards.
✅ Improved the lightning effects for the Arcane Broadsword.
✅ Added a unique model for the Teethy Worm’s offspring.

⚖️BALANCING⚖️
✅ Slightly reduced the damage of Aurora Wings for each extra target Augmentation.
🤝 Reduced the amount of HP added to enemies per Endless cycle.
✅ Added player position prediction to compensate for networking lag.
✅ Corrupted enemies attack 60% faster.
✅ Corrupted enemies are no longer corrupted after their last corruption attack.
🤝 Slightly increased gold rewards for longer runs.
🤝 Lowered the Gold threshold for unlocking the Infusion and New Spells Reroll button from 50,000 to 35,000.

⚙️STABILITY & BUGFIXES⚙️
✅ Fixed an issue where players had to cancel matchmaking twice.
🤝 Fixed several matchmaking problems.
🤝 Fixed an issue where damage numbers would reach an integer overflow.
🤝 Fixed an issue where all respawn beams were big when the host was playing with Campanelli.
🤝 Fixed an issue where corrupted enemies copied the Critical Hit Chance and Critical Damage from the player that corrupted it; instead, they now have a fixed 10% Critical Hit Chance and 150% Critical Damage.
✅ Fixed a shader issue that would lead to a game crash.
✅ Fixed an issue where duplicate resolutions were added to the settings, locking the player.
✅ Changed the description of the Rocky Road spell so it's more accurate.
🤝 Updated the description for healing Augmentations that only heal teammates (and not the caster).
✅ Fixed an issue where the death splash of an enemy killed by a corrupted enemy was in the opposite direction.
✅ Fixed an issue where enemies couldn't spawn fast enough after killing a lot of enemies.

✋ACCESSIBILITY ✋
🤝 Implemented a setting to enable/disable damage numbers.

🤝 = changes inspired by community feedback

Enjoy the update! We’ll be hard at work on Update 11, which will be released on July 2nd. You can expect some of the things we mentioned above. 🤫

BOLT BLASTER OUT

notes.title: 🧙 EA UPDATE 9 - DARK DEVOTION
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/377b2843787e0bbba1a4a9dec23d33a7871ca245.png

Our ninth early access update called Dark Devotion is now available! Check out the highlights below, or scroll to the bottom for the patch notes.

🌚Dark Element🌚
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/fc96e9993b9f863ea3ae1fd8d18dd71a0857d0e6.gif
We’re very excited to share this fifth element! You can now infuse your Spells with this Dark new element, which will allow you to corrupt enemies so they turn to your side. Oh, and you can also combine this element with the others, creating many new combos.

🌱Another Wizard🌱
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/284ad0117e314be892666b709c37d23e4b4f3b1c.gif
The Spell Brigade adds yet another Wizard! Bryony is a potion specialist/herb enthusiast, who is also half plant. Her signature Spell is called Vengeful Sprout, which grows giant plants that attack any enemy within range.

💀3 new Enemies💀
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/7bade75ffbdb0d5fa8ecae9c7e089dedc7d37432.gif

0.7 is here! We know this one features some highly requested and anticipated features so let’s just get down to it immediately:

👻INTRODUCING NEW ENEMIES
We've added 2 new enemies. Our questionable naming skills aside, behold...

THE SNEAKY BUG
Sneaky Bugs roam the Frozen Ancients, only running at you when your back’s turned to them (hence “sneaky”).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/8c5e88be7590409c302ea6f0fd8851c39639f745.gif

THE FLYING MANTA
Flying Mantas - get this - fly around the Pyrestorm Pit. They’ll draw on you quickly so beware! We’re also currently working on more Realm-specific enemies, but more on that later…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/8a4abb279d848f0d5aba18782fb05a7a7d0ce2f4.gif

📜INTRODUCING COVENANTS
The highly requested Friendly Fire toggle and Endless Mode have both been implemented in the form of Modifiers, which we’re calling Covenants. When selecting your Realm and Threat Level, you can now also activate any of the available Covenants to modify the rules of your run.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/213ea2a1d3df849e715612a07dee2d49b685b265.gif

Activate Harmony Pact to disable Friendly Fire, meaning you can’t hurt yourself or your teammates, and they can’t either. Activate Eternal Bond to enable Endless Mode, allowing you to keep playing after defeating Sol’phish, and starting a new cycle.

We plan to add more Covenants in the future, so we’re very excited to see what this brings to the game. Obviously, balancing an endless experience is very challenging, and we will be constantly improving this mode throughout Early Access to get it just right.

🌐MATCHMAKING IMPROVEMENTS
While these new features add a lot of value to the game, we quickly realized that this would also impact the matchmaking, as more choices for your run will also create more scattering of lobbies, making it potentially harder to match with the right players. And while our numbers are definitely growing, our player base is not THAT big to have many matches for each particular run choice.

That’s why we took some more time to not only improve the matchmaking process technically, but also give players some more options when trying to find players. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/c5fdc07c4f27b90f2eed7426b7d52f7b3240d86a.gif

By accessing the Matchmaking Options, you can now choose to prioritize your own run choices, or match with players in any run setup. We also added a meter for “Wizard Activity”, which essentially gives you a rough estimate of how easily you can find other players.

There are many more tiny fixes and improvements added, you can find those in the patch notes below:

It’s been a little over a week since we unleashed The Spell Brigade on all of you. We’ve released some small patches to get out some of the most prominent bugs and improve on some things like the matchmaking and the balancing.

In the meantime, we’ve also made some more stuff we wanted to release in a quick larger-than-the-last-but-relatively-still-small update! Check out the patch notes below:

NEW
🌟 Falling Stars: a new Spell
🪽 Archmage’s Blessing: a free Revive for dead Players to choose when leveling up.

BALANCING

✅ Increased the Pickup Distance for Health, Magnets, Mushrooms and Relics by 10%.
🤝 Decreased the Health of Statues by 10%.

IMPROVEMENTS
✅ Projectile-based Spells like the Astral Orbs, Rune Burst and Phantom Blade can now destroy each other on hit, reducing collateral friendly fire damage.

🤝 Improved obstacle layout in the Verdant Meadows to avoid exploits and players avoiding damage.
🤝 Fixed a visual issue where the Buffer enemy didn’t show the freeze effect when applied.
✅ Improved the VFX and Animations for the Statues Objective.
🤝 Added the option to open the Player Stats when choosing an Upgrade.
🤝 Fixed a visual issue where the level meter on a Spell Card would reset to 0 after reaching level 14 (second infusion).

✅ Added Player name tags to downed Players, so you can see who you are reviving.
✅ Localized the Logo in the Start Menu.
🤝 Your choice for enabling/disabling the Fill Up Squad toggle is now remembered.
🤝 Improved the flow between the Game Over and Lobby sequences.
✅ Added a prompt for canceling matchmaking, with a confirm popup for both hosts and clients.
✅ Improved the locked icons in the Wizard and Outfit Menus, teasing the content.

⚙️ Fixed a visual issue where the Revive effect had a weird/buggy transition.
🤝 Fixed an issue where exploding ticks would keep dropping XP when being damaged during their death sequence.
🤝 Fixed an issue where canceling matchmaking as the host would terminate the Lobby.

🤝 = changes inspired by community feedback

We hope you’ll enjoy this update! It’s not a whole lot, but we wanted to offer something new quickly to assure you that we’re constantly working on this game and want to make it as good as we can! 

We’re still very actively analyzing the feedback we’ve gathered from our players, and we’re close to getting a pretty good idea of what it is we want to make and what you guys want to see! So, you can expect an updated version of our roadmap soon.

There are still many requests, bug reports and improvement suggestions to go through, so we’ll leave you now and get back to work immediately!
